text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of raising children with patience and endurance, citing Prophetic hadiths and Qur'anic verses. It mentions that children are an amanah (trust) upon the parents, and that Islamic values must be taught to them. It also highlights that patience in the tarbiyah of children carries a great reward with Allah.

review_defects.english: raising children with patience and endurance
review_defects.why: The Arabic preposition 'على' means 'upon/on', indicating that children are to be raised to possess patience and endurance. The English 'with' suggests the parents' manner of raising, changing the core meaning from teaching children patience to being patient as a parent.
The Arabic phrase 'في أعناق' (on the necks) is omitted, losing the specific metaphor of a heavy responsibility placed directly on the parents' necks.
